purpose: Defines what the patient sees and can do online: book appointments, choose services, see prices, welcome message and video, and the deposit notice on booking.
tips: Only services marked as bookable online are offered.
The deposit notice does not cancel appointments: if the deposit does not arrive in time, reception cancels the appointment from the calendar.

config.patients-portal.section.access.label: Access
config.patients-portal.section.access.description: Whether the portal is enabled and what patients can do (book, cancel, see documents).

config.patients-portal.section.booking-s.label: Booking services
config.patients-portal.section.booking-s.description: Which services can be booked online.

config.patients-portal.section.booking-w.label: How far ahead patients can book
config.patients-portal.section.booking-w.description: The last date a patient can pick in the portal. It doesn't limit clinic staff.

config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.label: Amount
config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.description: How many days or months, depending on the chosen unit.

config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.label: Unit
config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.description: Days count from today. Months count calendar months: with 1, patients can only book in the current month.

config.patients-portal.section.deposit-n.label: Deposit notice
config.patients-portal.section.deposit-n.description: Message the patient sees after a new booking, also added to the booking email: the deposit they have to pay and the deadline to pay it.

config.patients-portal.field.deposit-ena.label: Deposit notice on booking
config.patients-portal.field.deposit-ena.description: When on, the patient sees the notice after booking and gets it by email. When off, booking ends as usual. It is not shown when rescheduling.

config.patients-portal.field.deposit-hou.label: Time to pay the deposit
config.patients-portal.field.deposit-hou.description: Hours from the booking (1 to 72). If the appointment starts earlier, the deadline is the appointment start. It is informational only: the appointment is not cancelled automatically.

config.patients-portal.tab.deposit-previ.label: Preview
config.patients-portal.tab.deposit-previ.description: Shows the notice as the patient sees it, with a sample appointment.

config.patients-portal.tab.deposit-html.label: HTML
config.patients-portal.tab.deposit-html.description: Code editor for the notice, with the variables to insert.

config.patients-portal.field.deposit-htm.label: Notice content (HTML)
config.patients-portal.field.deposit-htm.description: The notice HTML, with variables such as {{deadline}} or {{clinic_phone}} that are filled in with each booking. Use inline styles: it is the same content as the email.

config.patients-portal.btn.deposit-resto.label: Restore template
config.patients-portal.btn.deposit-resto.description: Goes back to the starter template. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

config.patients-portal.section.deposit-p.label: Preview
config.patients-portal.section.deposit-p.description: How the notice looks with a sample appointment tomorrow at 10:00.

config.patients-portal.section.presentat.label: Presentation
config.patients-portal.section.presentat.description: Texts and details the patient sees.
